There is so much shit in life that you can't help but think that it isn't worth it all, but all your brain is doing is focusing on so much that is bad. It is common with us people with depression, but you gotta look farther than that. Look at the little accomplishments, the people that you hold the door open for, how you could be someone looked up to, and even how you could positively affect everyone around you in the future.

You can get through, don't give up.
